payment_terms.value_text: Payment must be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement.
payment_terms.quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.4 for an IPC;
payment_terms.notes: Clause 19.5 also mentions an earlier part payment within 10 days of receipt of recommendation. Interest on delayed payment is Bank Rate + 3% per annum.
payment_terms.reasoning: Excerpt on page 106 under Clause 19.9(i)(a) states that payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority's Engineer. There is also a partial electronic payment provision on page 104 within 10 days of the engineer's recommendation, but the main interim payment period is 30 days from submission. Therefore, 30 days is reported as the numeric value with day type unspecified.

retention.value_text: 6% deducted from every payment for works as retention money, subject to a maximum of 5% of the Contract Price.
retention.quote: the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
retention.notes: Refund of the balance retention money occurs within 15 days of the date of issue of the Completion Certificate.
retention.reasoning: Excerpt on page 53 explicitly sets out Clause 7.5 for Retention Money, stating that the Authority shall deduct 6% from every payment for works as guarantee money, subject to a maximum amount not exceeding 5% of the Contract Price. The per-bill deduction rate is 6% and the cap is 5% of the Contract Price. Therefore, numeric_value is 6 and cap_percent is 5.

advance.value_text: 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses, paid in two equal instalments, plus an additional 5% equipment advance.
advance.quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “Advance Payment”) @ “Bank Rate + 3%”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisation expenses.
advance.notes: Includes an additional 5% advance for key construction equipment on page 102. Interest is charged at Bank Rate + 3% and recovered via 15% deductions from each stage payment.
advance.reasoning: Pages 101 and 243 explicitly state that an interest-bearing advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price shall be made exclusively for mobilisation expenses, divided into two equal instalments of 5% each. Page 102 also mentions an additional 5% equipment advance against a Bank Guarantee. The advance carries interest at 'Bank Rate + 3%' and is recovered through 15% deductions from each stage payment.

liquidated_damages.value_text: 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay in achieving Project Milestones or the Scheduled Completion Date.
liquidated_damages.quote: it shall pay Damages to the Authority of a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five percent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule –J and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Project Highway is completed
liquidated_damages.notes: Applies after a period of 30 days from the date set forth in Schedule-J. Page 89 also mentions a separate damages rate of 0.1% of the monthly maintenance payment for lane closure delays.
liquidated_damages.reasoning: Page 67 sets out the contractor's liquidated damages for failure to achieve project milestones or the scheduled completion date. The rate is 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay after a 30-day grace period. Another penalty for lane closures is mentioned on page 89, but page 67 represents the primary contractor's delay penalty for the completion of works/milestones.

escalation.value_text: Price adjustment applies to works and maintenance based on cost component indices and formulas.
escalation.quote: The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works shall be adjusted in accordance with the provisions of this Clause 19.10
escalation.notes: Detailed component percentages and formulas are provided across pages 106 to 109 under clauses 19.10, 19.11, and 19.12.
escalation.reasoning: The excerpts contain multiple provisions for price adjustment, specifically Clauses 19.10, 19.11, and 19.12, detailing mechanisms for adjusting costs based on indices for labour, materials, fuel, and other inputs for both works and maintenance. Therefore, price escalation is found and handled via specific formulas rather than a flat percentage rate.

performance_security.value_text: Performance security equal to 3% of the Bid Price in the form of an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee.
performance_security.quote: Within 30 (thirty) days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance, the selected Bidder shall furnish to the Authority an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-G (the “Performance Security”) for an amount equal to 3% (Three percent) of its Bid Price.
performance_security.notes: Must be provided within 30 days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance as a bank guarantee. Valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period. Additional performance security may apply for abnormally low bids.
performance_security.reasoning: Excerpt on page 51 clearly states under Article 7.1 that the selected bidder must furnish a performance security for an amount equal to 3% of its bid price via an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee. The excerpt also discusses additional performance security rules and validity periods. Therefore, numeric_value is 3 and the unit is '% of bid price'.
